facts.fact: Gopan is the old keeper of the cistern chain and wheel, nineteen years in the post, who missed one hour in 'the fever year'.
facts.why: needed because the tour shows the hourly chain and Neela's habit is to learn every servant's name.

facts.fact: Bhaskaran is the sergeant at the padippura. Unni is a thin young guard whose mother sells salt fish in the lower village.
facts.why: needed because Neela collects guard names and rotations on the tour.

facts.fact: The day watch changes on the sixth clank of the cistern chain after dawn.
facts.why: needed because Neela collects guard rotations as part of her goal.

facts.fact: Pepper is Kannan's white goat, who bites.
facts.why: small texture detail for the goat-boy scene.

facts.fact: Janu says Devan used to have a kalari partner and now trains alone, a gap of eight years.
facts.why: consistent with the bible's eight years without sparring and needed for the kalari stop on the tour.
